<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule. The only way to infer this without a structural description is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample, which will show signals for aromatic carbons (typically in the 110‑160 ppm region). By counting those distinct aromatic carbon signals we can determine the aromatic carbon count. This requires a single, inexpensive measurement, so we’ll request the carbon NMR spectrum.</thought>
